message: Power outages can really throw a wrench in our day, can’t they? I remember the last one we had, the family group chat lit up with everyone sharing their best ideas for passing the time and staying cozy. It's a good reminder to have a few fun activities and essentials in mind for those moments. It might be worth checking out a great resource I found that offers tips on preparing for power outages. How does your family stay connected and entertained during a blackout?
